arabic text: Aakhir hussain maa hoon\nKaise gale pe tere khanjar me chalta dekhoon\nGardan pe rakh ke terri apna gala katadu
english translation text: After all, I am Hussain's mother.\nHow can I watch the dagger move across your throat?\nLet me place my own neck upon yours and have my throat cut.

arabic text: Chere pe lagay khoo'n ko anchal se me chura du!!\nZano pe rakh kay sar ko balo'n se gard jharo!!\nAnso baha baha kay pani tujhe pila du!!
english translation text: Let me wipe the blood from your face with my veil;\nlet me place your head upon my knees and brush the dust from your hair;\nlet me pour out my tears and give you water.

arabic text: Me maa hu apnay dil ko behlao kis tarha se!!\nTo khak par ha sota me jao kis tarha se!!\nKis tarha tujhko run me tanha me chor jao!!
english translation text: I am your mother—how can I console my heart?\nYou lie upon the dust; how can I leave?\nHow can I abandon you alone in the battlefield?

arabic text: Nazo se tujhko pala khud chakiya'n hain pissi!!\nLakin kis jaga per taqdeer lae teri!!\nGhoray se tu giray jab aa kar tuje sambhalo!!
english translation text: I raised you with love and ground the millstones myself;\nyet to what place has destiny brought you?\nWhen you fall from the horse, let me come and hold you.

arabic text: Waqt e kathin ha beta tujhko laga kay man se!!\nik ek kar kay khencho har teer ko badan se!!\nLakin batao beta himat kaha se lao'n!!
english translation text: This is a difficult hour, my son. Let me hold you to my chest\nand pull every arrow from your body one by one;\nbut tell me, my son, where can I find such strength?

arabic text: Wo umr e nojawani or phir ye nagahani!!\nAkbar nay khayi barchi phir bhi mila na pani!!\nBetay ka zakhm kia ha ye bhi me janti hu!!
english translation text: Such youth, and then this sudden calamity;\nAkbar was struck by the spear and still received no water.\nI too know what the wound of a son means.

arabic text: Zakhm e jigar ha gehra or khoon beh raha ha!!\nAmma yaha se jao tu kio ye keh raha ha!!\nAa mere lal tujhko kitni dafa batao'n!!
english translation text: The wound in your heart is deep, and blood is flowing.\nWhy do you say, 'Mother, leave this place'?\nCome, my beloved—how many times must I tell you?

arabic text: Girya kuna'n zameen ha rota ye asma'n ha!!\nTere galay pe beta khanjar rawa'n dawa'n ha!!\nTeri galay ko apni chadar se me chupao'n!!
english translation text: The earth laments and the heavens weep;\nthe dagger moves across your throat, my son.\nLet me cover your neck with my chadar.
